Item 8.01. Other Events.

As previously disclosed, on July 21, 2026, GoPro, Inc. (the “Company”) received notice from The Nasdaq Stock Market (“Nasdaq”) indicating that the Company was not in compliance with the minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 per share under the Nasdaq Listing Rules. On September 16, 2026, the Company received notice from Nasdaq that it has regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement under the Nasdaq Listing Rules. The Company’s stock price has maintained a closing bid price above $1.00 per share for at least ten consecutive business days, thereby meeting Nasdaq’s requirements for regaining compliance.
